clips.topic: Why This AI Boom Is Not the Dot-Com Bubble
clips.viral_hook: Sure, it feels like it's a hype cycle because capital spending in the tech and telecom sectors as a percent of GDP is nearly as high now as it was during the tech and telecom bubble.

He's saying, "Those aren't dark. They're in short supply, and they are being used." And we agree completely with that. We compare this capital spending cycle to the railroads in the 1800s.
